data.name: Raphaela
data.gender_notes: Raphaela is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Raphaela is derived from the Hebrew word 'Rapha' which means 'healing, to heal'. In the Bible, Raphael is an angel named in the book of Tobit. Raphaela's name symbolizes God's healing power and the idea that God is always present to heal and restore. The name Raphaela carries the meaning “God has healed” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Raphaela usually hope their child will grow to embody god has healed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of God's healing power and presence.
data.etymology: Raphaela belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God has healed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raphaela total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_latin.name: Raphaela

in_english.name: Raphaela
in_english.long_meaning: Raphaela is the feminine form of Raphael, meaning God's healing angel, derived from Hebrew roots, and although not directly mentioned in the New Testament, the figure of Raphael as a healing angel has influenced Christian tradition and is associated with spiritual healing and protection

data.cultural_impact: Raphaela is a beautiful and meaningful name rooted in the rich tradition of the Hebrew language and the Bible. It evokes feelings of hope, healing, and divine guidance.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Raphaela: God has healed. This name embodies the divine intervention and healing power of God. It is a reminder that no matter our trials or afflictions, His grace and mercy are always sufficient to heal and restore.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Raphaela is a variant of Raphael, which is derived from Hebrew "Raphael", meaning God heals. The name Raphaela carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Raphaela was used in medieval Europe as a feminine form of Raphael

trends: Raphaela is a trendy name in some European countries
